items.docs: Returns unique non-empty email addresses from donations to this fundraising page. Each email appears only once, even if the donor made multiple donations. Donations without email are intentionally excluded. Pagination counts reflect unique emails, not total donations. Optimized for bulk operations like 'copy all emails'.
